gotchas: Deliberately NOT placed on solark-hybrid-rtu-v1. The only Sol-Ark register map in existence publicly is V1.4, dated 2023-10-13, whose title enumerates "5k, 8k, 12k, 15k" and whose pinout sections cover 8K, 12K indoor, outdoor 5K/8K/12K and 15K. The 18K postdates it and appears nowhere in it. Same vendor and same "-2P"

What is missing to resolve it: a V1.5-or-later Sol-Ark Modbus RTU Protocol document naming the 18K, or two independent implementations reading an 18K at specific addresses. Sol-Ark will send the map on request — 18K Installation Manual Rev 13 §2.3: "Modbus map is available upon request for READ operations only. Contact

Circumstantial only, and NOT sufficient to assign: the 18K manual's §2.3 text, RJ45 pin table and Modbus-SN wording are word-for-word identical to the 15K Rev 13 manual, and the 18K's parallel/Modbus-SN and fault-code sections match too. That suggests a shared platform, not a verified shared register map. Note the 18K
Same read-only expectation applies if a map does arrive: the vendor's blanket statement across every manual is "READ operations only."
